designSummary: Rapid review with random-effects meta-analysis of proportions for safety and yield when at least five studies report them.
sampleSize: The unit of analysis is the study. The 2022 meta-analysis pooled about 18,000 ruled-out patients, so a pooled 30-day event rate near 0.3 percent is estimated to within about 0.15 percentage points; the update matters for the age and kidney subgroups, where one study of 2,310 older patients gives a yield estimate within about 2 percentage points. Pooling within subgroups needs at least three studies reporting them.
primaryAnalysis: Random-effects meta-analysis of the proportion of ruled-out patients with 30-day death or myocardial infarction on the logit scale, with 95 percent confidence and prediction intervals; certainty rated with GRADE.
secondaryAnalysis: Meta-analysis of rule-out yield overall and by age 75 or over and kidney function where reported; time in the department and timing failures summarised as medians and ranges.
missingData: No author contact; studies without 30-day follow-up for all ruled-out patients are flagged and removed in a sensitivity analysis.
multiplicity: One primary safety outcome; subgroup estimates presented descriptively with intervals.
overfittingGuards: No threshold comparisons beyond those reported
summary: Proportion meta-analysis for safety and yield; the update adds precision where it matters, in older and kidney patients.
